rv.q: Instead, Steppenwolf Theatre Company is staging the world premiere of a predictable moral satire, which is of course not a satire at all...
Adirondack Chair Circle is both funny and powerful.
This is the kind of juicy uneasy theatre which Steppenwolf excels at.
But Adirondack Chair Circle offers little to challenge the people already on its side, either.
“Adirondack Chair Circle” is a snapshot of our time, and it is timeless in its appeal.

This is a well written, nicely performed, thought provoking play that might have you considering how much control parents are entitled to have when it comes to ideas that might be considered controversial to some and how much we are willing to sacrifice for our cause.
The cast is so spot-on that it almost carried the day, despite the extra unnecessary hour in length.
